people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: “Don’t let the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape. In the north by the river Euphrates they have stumbled and fallen.
translations.bsb: “The swift cannot flee, and the warrior cannot escape! In the north by the River Euphrates they stumble and fall.
translations.kjv: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; they shall stumble, and fall toward the north by the river Euphrates.
translations.asv: Let not the swift flee away, nor the mighty man escape; in the north by the river Euphrates have they stumbled and fallen.
